methodology_notes.ddm_gate: DDM mechanically broken: P=D1/(Ke-g)=1.66/(0.37-0.08)=5.72 TL. TRY Ke~37% makes DDM produce nonsensical values. Weight: 0%.
methodology_notes.sotp_gate: HOLDING=FALSE. Subsidiaries (Aserva, ETM Astor Sarl, Astor Energy Algeria, Astor Sarz) are financially immaterial or newly formed. SOTP not applicable.
methodology_notes.try_wacc_trap: Raw TRY CAPM WACC 37-39% produces DCF values 65-110 TL/share vs market 203.50 TL. Market prices ASTOR on EV/EBITDA relatives, not TRY DCF. DCF used as floor/reference only.
methodology_notes.ias29_distortion: FY2025 monetary loss -8,068.56M TRY = 105% of reported net income 7,669M. IAS29 must be isolated. Adjusted NOPAT ~9,621M TRY used for P/E analysis.
methodology_notes.guidance_haircut: FY2024 miss -8.6%, FY2025 miss ~-6.1%. Two consecutive misses → 85% realization factor applied to FY2026 $1,223M guidance → effective ~$1,040M

dcf_model.wacc_rationale: 25-28% TRY CAPM band per memory. 12% market-implied. 18% used as conservative midpoint acknowledging structural TRY rate environment

conclusion.valuation_verdict: FAIRLY VALUED (probability-weighted ~209 TL vs market 203.50 TL, +2.7%)
conclusion.key_message: ASTOR trades near fair value on probability-weighted basis. NTM EV/EBITDA (13.8x) is modestly below peer median (14.2x), suggesting re-rating potential if FY2026 guidance is achieved. TRY DCF cannot explain market price — EV/EBITDA is the governing valuation framework for this name.
conclusion.disclaimer: This report does not constitute a buy or sell recommendation. Fair value estimates are for reference only.
